build_EQDSK_geometry: build a StandardGeometry from an EQDSK file using EQDSKConfig with COCOS convention and plasma parameters
construct_EQDSK_intermediates: construct StandardGeometryIntermediates from an EQDSK geometry file with flux surface averages
validate_EQDSK_cocos11: validate that EQDSK data complies with COCOS11 coordinate conventions for positive B0 and Ip
calculate_flux_surface_averages: calculate flux surface averages including <1/R>, <Bp^2>, and plasma current profiles from EQDSK contours
generate_flux_surface_contours: generate closed flux surface contours from a 2D psi mesh using contourpy on EQDSK geometry data
